claim_scope: Research-only executable Tau evidence for proof-carrying mutation with explicit predecessor-relative constitutional receipts. Covers monotone ratchets, four-way amendment relation classification, invariant-kernel mutable policy, order-sensitive restrict/extend updates, and a temporal receipt carrying predecessor, proposal, both directional residues, kernel-violation residue, and exact adopted/rejected effective law.
failure_modes: mixed amendments are collapsed into a one-bit weakening/strengthening label
a global meet ratchet silently synthesizes a third law while being reported as exact proposal adoption
an approved proposal escapes the protected invariant kernel
a rejected unsafe proposal changes the effective predecessor law
directional semantic residues are omitted from the transition receipt
restrict-then-extend ordering is treated as universally commutative
replay runs against a mutable Tau source instead of the exact research lock

aaa.reason: The replay arranges equivalent, strengthening, weakening, mixed, hostile, approved and rejected mutations; acts through exact-source Tau theorem queries and temporal ADT streams; and asserts frozen theorem verdicts plus terminal receipt states.

reject_is_noop.reason: The receipt trace explicitly routes an unsafe proposal with approved=0, selecting predecessor rather than proposal, while still exposing proposal and kernel-violation residue in the receipt.

boundary_dimensions.name: transition_decision
points: approved kernel-preserving mixed proposal adopts exact proposal

boundary_dimensions.name: protected_kernel
points: proof kernel remains mandatory under arbitrary future policy

nonclaims: Research-only logical evidence; no production, settlement, governance-execution, release, migration, verifier, or value-moving authority.
The approved gate is an abstract Tau value constrained to 0/1; this experiment does not define who may authorize an amendment or how authorization is cryptographically authenticated.
The protected kernel is assumed to have a separate higher-order amendment mechanism; constitutional bootstrapping and kernel replacement are not solved here.
Directional residues classify semantic relation but are not canonical cryptographic commitments until separately encoded and root-bound.
The coordination theorem identifies semantic order sensitivity but does not implement consensus ordering, locking, sequencing, or a scheduler.
The examples do not establish production signatures, hashes, canonical serialization, persistence, or Tau Net consensus behavior.
This evidence does not close O-008 or refresh any pre-existing formal-cycle packet.
